summary.text: The match ended in a draw after IREA made 551-10 in their first innings, featuring a top score of 144 off 188 balls by Gavin Hoey and best bowling figures of 4 for 96 by Shelton Mazvitorera. ZIMA responded with 329-10 in their first innings, where Kudzai Maunze top-scored with 57 off 111 balls and Reuben Wilson took 4 for 80, before following on to finish their second innings at 214-3 with Dion Myers scoring 101 off 217 balls and Reuben Wilson claiming 1 for 27.
